InkPad Notebook 0.3.0
PB743K3 install package

1. Connect the reader.
2. Open the applications folder.
3. Copy InkPad-Notebook.app there.
4. Create textEditor at root.
5. Copy text files there.
6. Copy kbLayouts/fr.keys to:
   system/config/textEditor/map.keys
7. Pair the keyboard.
8. Eject the reader safely.
9. Launch InkPad Notebook.

The app targets PB743K3.
The binary needs InkView.
Reader testing remains required.

Rollback:
Delete applications/InkPad-Notebook.app.
Leave textEditor files intact.
